# Design-time errors and warnings

Diagnostics reported by the IDE integration of Metalama.

| Article | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| <xref:lama0301> | An error defined by an aspect is shown under a temporary ID because the IDE session doesn't know its ID yet. |
| <xref:lama0302> | A warning defined by an aspect is shown under a temporary ID because the IDE session doesn't know its ID yet. |
| <xref:lama0303> | An informational diagnostic defined by an aspect is shown under a temporary ID because the IDE session doesn't know its ID yet. |
| <xref:lama0304> | A hidden diagnostic defined by an aspect is shown under a temporary ID because the IDE session doesn't know its ID yet. |
| <xref:lama0306> | A diagnostic suppression defined by an aspect isn't applied in the IDE because the IDE session doesn't know it yet. |
| <xref:lama0307> | The project includes the same source file several times, so Metalama analyzes only one copy at design time. |
